content.title: Is CVS open on Easter? What to know about 2025 holiday hours
content.text: Easter has officially arrived. However you're spending the holiday this year — whether it's gathering with friends or coloring eggs with the kids — it's entirely possible that you just remembered there's a prescription waiting for you at CVS. Or, perhaps, a loved one came down with seasonal allergies and you don't have any tissues on hand.Whatever the case may be, if you need to visit your local pharmacy this Sunday, you might be wondering what CVS Easter hours are in 2025. Given that many stores, restaurants and businesses are closed in observance of the holy holiday, it's reasonable to question if your go-to pharmacy is open on April 20. To ensure your Easter celebration is a success, TODAY.com reached out to the pharmacy chain to find out details on whether or not CVS stores will be open or closed on Sunday and what store hours will be. That way, you can be assured that whatever essentials or necessities you need this weekend can be picked out without any hassle. See below to learn the specifics on CVS store hours and the most up-to-date pharmacy information this Easter.CVS Easter hours for 2025A CVS spokesperson tells TODAY.com via email that "CVS Pharmacy locations will be open on Easter, although some stores may have reduced hours."To ensure a pharmacy near you is open when you arrive, the pharmacy chain recommends that customers call their local store before visiting or check hours at cvs.com.
